_comment: Tier-2 for febio::hyperelasticity#4. Two decks differing only in <step_size> (10 x 1.0 and 10 x 0.1) both reach normal termination with exit 0 and both report 10 completed steps — the fixture asserts that equality, because it is what makes the step count useless as a check — while the last *Time in the logfile CSV is 10 for the first and 1 for the second. Both final times are required to equal time_steps x step_size. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'final_time_not_step_count=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
